anomalies.description: A group of armed men in an outdoor industrial setting, with aggressive postures and weapons drawn, indicating collective violent unrest or imminent violent confrontation.
A man in the foreground is holding a firearm and aiming it forward; other armed individuals are visible behind him in a tense standoff, consistent with an active shooting situation.
A large armed group confronts a vehicle (bus) in an urban derelict setting; they advance, aim, and open fire collectively, constituting violent group unrest directed at property/occupants.
Multiple armed individuals fire automatic weapons toward the yellow bus; visible muzzle flashes and bullet impacts on the bus are present.
A group of armed men fire automatic weapons in a coordinated volley; muzzle flashes and smoke are visible from multiple firearms.
Organized armed group engages in violent collective action against a vehicle (bus), involving coordinated firing, destruction, and presence of multiple combatants in an urban derelict setting.

Continued gunfire against the bus; bullet holes appear on the bus exterior, smoke and sparks visible from impacts; interior view shows sparks flying inside from incoming rounds.; Intense gunfire inside the bus, with sparks and debris flying as bullets strike interior surfaces; visible through windows and open door.
Continued sustained shooting by multiple individuals outside; muzzle flashes, spent casings on ground, and bullet impacts on bus exterior confirm active gunfire.
A yellow school bus is shown with heavy smoke and fire erupting from its front/rear; likely result of an explosion or intense gunfire impact.

A man in a black tank top is holding a firearm and appears to be firing, with motion blur suggesting rapid action; smoke and debris visible near a yellow vehicle in subsequent frames suggest impact or discharge.
Sudden burst of smoke and debris emanating from the side of the yellow bus, consistent with an explosive impact; frame f1 shows dense smoke and structural distortion near the bus body.

The yellow bus is shown heavily damaged, with smoke and visible deformation; while not a collision captured in motion, the state suggests a recent high-impact crash or blast-induced vehicle damage occurring just before or during this interval.

Close-up of three men holding and aiming assault rifles; one man’s weapon shows clear muzzle flash in f14, confirming active firing.; Multiple armed individuals (at least four) are aiming assault rifles in a coordinated manner; bullet holes appear on the yellow bus windows in later frames (f8–f10), confirming active gunfire directed at the vehicle.
A person in a hooded jacket is visibly aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash or recoil is implied by posture and weapon orientation in frames f3–f5.
A large armed group (≥8 individuals) advances in formation with rifles, displaying coordinated aggressive posture in an urban alleyway—consistent with violent group unrest or armed confrontation.

Multiple individuals in the armed group are holding rifles in ready-to-fire positions; one individual in foreground (f8–f9) appears to be actively aiming/engaging, though no muzzle flash is visible. Given context and posture, shooting is highly probable during this interval.
A person is seen holding and aiming a rifle inside a bus; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the posture and weapon handling strongly suggest an imminent or ongoing shooting action.

Two individuals are in close proximity inside the bus, one holding a rifle while the other appears to be grappling or restraining from behind; physical contact and tension suggest mutual combat or struggle.
